description: Balmorel Model is a framework listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Frameworks", published or maintained by RAM-lose, DTU Danish Technical University, NMBU Norwegian University of Life Sciences, TTU Tallinn University of Technology, EA Energianalyse. EU-driven liberalization of energy markets implied need for international overview, understanding, and communication by analyzing relevant issues for the energy sector for better understanding, communication and decision making. Coverage: Regional, National, Local/community. Methodical focus: Energy supply, Environmental, Integrated approach, Modular build-up, Energy dispatch, Capacity expansion planning, Unit commitment, Sector-coupling. Software: MS Excel / VBA, GAMS. Initial release: 2001-01-01. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ISC license. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
